Dec. 10, 1942.

General Meeting of the Supporters of the
"Eastjewoom" Organization on the 6th. of
December, 1942.

At 5 p.m on the 6th. of Dec. 1942, at the Shanghai
Jewish Club, 1623 Avenue Road, a General Meeting of all
Supporters of the "Eastjewoom" (Committee for the Assist-
ance to Jewish Refugees from Eastern Europe) was held.
Approximately 250 persons were present. The meeting was
opened at 5 p.m. sharp by A. Oppenheim, Chairman of the
"Eastjewoom", who proposed to elect a President and a
Secretary for the present meeting. Two candidates were
seconded for the President, namely: J. Brick and B.
Radomishelsky, resulting that J. Brick was elected and
S. Finland was elected as the Secretary for the meeting.

NOTE: It has here to be stated that the assembled persons,
as noticed by the undersigned, even before the
beginning of the meeting, could be divided in two
distinct groups with antagonistic feelings against
each other, namely the largest group supporting the
existing Committee (A. Oppenheim), which was for the
election of J. Brick, and the other group of the
"Centrjewoom" (headed by L.M. Rogovin), which group
was for the election of B. Radomishelsky as the
President of the meeting and were against the policy
of the existing "Eastjewoom", because this Committee
refused to share their funds in order to help the
German Jewish Refugees.

J. Brick and S. Finland then took the chair under
protest of L.M. Rogovin, who stated that it was a shame,
because B. Radomishelsky being the President of the
Ashkenazi Jewish Communal Association should preside over
this meeting. This protest caused a slight disorder
of the meeting and Rogovin was not allowed to proceed
with his speech. M. Walkowsky, Secretary of the
"Eastjewoom" then made a report on the activities of the
organization since its foundation, March 1941, giving
pages.zh:
外事、
刑事及特别部门
1942年12月10日。

1942年12月6日
“东犹委”（Eastjewoom）组织支持者全体会议。

1942年12月6日下午5时，在爱文义路（Avenue Road）1623号上海犹太俱乐部，举行了“东犹委”（东欧犹太难民援助委员会）所有支持者的全体会议。约有250人出席。会议由“东犹委”主席 A. Oppenheim 于下午5时整宣布开幕，他提议选举本次会议的主席和秘书。主席职位有两名候选人获得附议，分别是：J. Brick 和 B. Radomishelsky，结果 J. Brick 当选，S. Finland 当选为会议秘书。

注：此处必须指出，据签署人观察，甚至在会议开始之前，与会人员就可以分为两个彼此怀有敌意的明显群体，即支持现有委员会（A. Oppenheim）的最大群体，该群体支持选举 J. Brick；以及“中犹委”（由 L.M. Rogovin 领导）的另一群体，该群体支持选举 B. Radomishelsky 为会议主席，并反对现有“东犹委”的政策，因为该委员会拒绝分享其资金以援助德国犹太难民。

随后，J. Brick 和 S. Finland 在 L.M. Rogovin 的抗议声中就任主席职位，Rogovin 称这是一种耻辱，因为 B. Radomishelsky 作为阿什肯纳兹犹太社区协会的主席，本应主持此次会议。这一抗议导致会议出现轻微混乱，Rogovin 未被允许继续其演讲。随后，“东犹委”秘书 M. Walkowsky 就该组织自1941年3月成立以来的活动作了报告，提供了

pages.en:
- 2 -

rough figures of the number of refugees from Poland,
Lithuanian and Latvia, supported by the "Eastjewcom",
that at present there were about 1010 such persons in
Shanghai, but only 850 persons receive support from the
organisation and that they were Jews of very religious
inclinations, therefore have to be fed separately and
formerly (in 1941) refused to eat the food offered to
them from a communal kitchen, preferring starvation.
He further stated that in March 1941 the refugees
received only a support of $10.00 per month each, but that
owing to good work done by the committee members and the
supporters for the good cause by donating money, resulted
that at present the refugees receive $30 per month and in
addition $15.00 for quarters. However this sum is not
sufficient to live on owing to the present high cost of
living. Besides the refugees receive medical care and
in the first months of existence of the "Eastjewcom" spent
about $100.00 per month on medical care, whilst now the
Committee has to spend about $22,000.00 per month for
this purpose, and that this is a proof that the refugees
are underfed and therefore more exposed to contracting
sicknesses. That two Charity Balls were arranged for the
benefit of the refugees and the first ball, on the 26th.,
July, 1948, was successful in so far that $40,000.00 was
donated, however from this sum over $20,000 has not been
collected yet, but only "I.O.U." chits are in the
Committee's cash box. That the present monthly donations
are very small - about $15,000 only. Therefore asking
all supporters to cover their debts with the Committee.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

由“东犹委”支持的来自波兰、立陶宛和拉脱维亚的难民人数的粗略数据，指出目前上海约有1010名此类人员，但只有850人接受该组织的援助，且他们是具有强烈宗教倾向的犹太人，因此必须单独供餐，并且以前（1941年）拒绝食用公共厨房提供的食物，宁愿挨饿。他进一步指出，1941年3月，难民每人每月仅获得10.00美元的援助，但由于委员会成员的良好工作以及支持者出于善意捐款，目前难民每月可获得30美元，此外还有15.00美元的住房补贴。然而，由于目前生活成本高昂，这笔金额不足以维持生活。此外，难民还接受医疗护理，在“东犹委”成立的最初几个月，每月医疗支出约为100.00美元，而现在委员会每月在此方面的支出约为22,000.00美元，这证明难民营养不良，因此更容易患病。为难民利益安排了两场慈善舞会，第一场舞会于1948年7月26日举行（原文如此），其成功之处在于募集了40,000.00美元捐款，然而这笔款项中超过20,000美元尚未收讫，委员会保险箱里只有“欠条”（I.O.U.）纸条。目前的月度捐款非常少——仅约15,000美元。因此，请求所有支持者偿还欠委员会的债务。

pages.en:
- 3 -

The second Charity Ball was not so successful and only
a sum of $40,000 was collected during the occasion.
A total sum of approximately $1,660,000 was collected
by the "Eastjewcom" from March 1941 up to December, 1942,
for support of the refugees from Eastern Europe. This
sum was collected as follows:-
    45 o/o received from the joint distributing
    committee in New York
    23 o/o received from various Jewish Communities and
    other Jewish Organs (Harbin, Tientsin, Hankow etc.)
    32 o/o received from local Jewish Organisations and
    private persons
Included in the last 32 o/o from the local Jewry are the
abovementioned sums from the proceeds of the two Charity
Balls - $460,000.00 and $40,000.00.
    This report of the Secretary of the "Eastjewcom"
underwent a very strict criticism from the supporters of
the meeting.
NOTE: It has to be stated that several members of the
"Eastjewcom" resigned in August, 1942, being
dissatisfied that same did not wish to cooperate
with the "Centrjewcom".
    N. Klebanoff, one of the former members of the
"Eastjewcom" then made a speech in which he severely
criticised the activities of the "Eastjewcom" and
especially its president, A. Oppenheim, stating that
according to the above report made by the Secretary,
"Eastjewcom" received 45 o/o (approximately $800,000.00)
of the sums collected from the Joint Distributing
Committee in New York, however refused to give $20,000.00
for children of destitute Jewish parents from Central
pages.zh:
- 3 -

第二次慈善舞会并不成功，活动期间仅筹集到40,000美元。从1941年3月至1942年12月，“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”（Eastjewcom）共筹集约1,660,000美元，用于援助来自东欧的难民。这笔款项的来源如下：
    45% 来自纽约联合分配委员会（Joint Distributing Committee）；
    23% 来自各地犹太社区及其他犹太机构（哈尔滨、天津、汉口等）；
    32% 来自本地犹太组织及个人。
在上述来自本地犹太界的32%中，包含了前述两次慈善舞会的收入——460,000.00美元和40,000.00美元。
    “东欧犹太难民救济委员会”秘书的这份报告遭到了与会支持者的严厉批评。
注：必须指出，“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”的几名成员于1942年8月辞职，原因是该委员会不愿与“中央犹太难民救济委员会”（Centrjewcom）合作，令他们感到不满。
    N. Klebanoff（音译），前“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”成员之一，随后发表演讲，严厉批评了“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”的活动，特别是其主席A. Oppenheim（音译）。他指出，根据秘书的上述报告，“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”收到了来自纽约联合分配委员会所筹款项的45%（约800,000.00美元），然而当“联合委员会”（Joint）代表提出要求时，却拒绝拿出20,000.00美元用于资助中欧贫困犹太父母的子女。

pages.en:
- 4 -

Europe, when asked by the representatives of the "Joint"
and that such action was a shame on the Committee members
of the "Eastjewcom".

The other speakers were D. Rabinovitch, Y.Beerbrayer,
and L.M. Rogovin, all three members of the "Centrjewcom",
and all of them criticised the activity of the "Eastjewcom"
A great commotion amongst the assembled persons started
when L.M. Rogovin, Chairman of the "Centrjewcom", made
his speech in which he stated that the "Centrjewcom" has
done more in three months than the "Eastjewcom" in 22
months and that in avoiding assistance in the feeding of
destitute children by refusing to give $30,000 as asked
by the representatives of "Joint" can be regarded as a
culpable activity of all members of the committee and most
of all their chairman (A. Oppenheim). L.M. Rogovin did
not finish his speech because by that time a terrible
noise was raised by the people who were in favour of the
committee and for A.Oppenheim in particular. Many of the
persons got up from their seats and shouts were heard -
"Down with Rogovin", "Take him out" and similar replies.
About 5-7 minutes passed before the President of the
meeting was able to gain control of the meeting.

D. Rabinovitch then drew a resolution and proposed
that same to be passed by the meeting which was as
follows:-

That the "Eastjewcom" and the "Centrjewcom" organi-
zations each elect two amongst their members - in all 4
persons - who shall build a so-called "Roof Committee"
pages.zh:
- 4 -

其他发言者包括D. Rabinovitch（音译）、Y. Beerbrayer（音译）和L.M. Rogovin（音译），此三人均为“中央犹太难民救济委员会”成员，他们都批评了“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”的活动。当“中央犹太难民救济委员会”主席L.M. Rogovin发表演讲时，在场人群中引发了巨大的骚动。他在演讲中指出，“中央犹太难民救济委员会”在三个月内所做的工作比“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”在22个月内做的还要多；并且，拒绝按照“联合委员会”代表的要求提供30,000美元以援助贫困儿童的饮食，这种行为可被视为委员会所有成员，尤其是其主席（A. Oppenheim）的失职行为。L.M. Rogovin未能完成他的演讲，因为此时支持该委员会、特别是支持A. Oppenheim的人群发出了巨大的噪音。许多人从座位上站起来，高喊“打倒Rogovin”、“把他赶出去”以及类似的口号。大约过了5到7分钟，会议主席才重新控制住会场秩序。

随后，D. Rabinovitch起草了一项决议，并提议由会议通过，内容如下：

由“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”和“中央犹太难民救济委员会”两个组织各自从其成员中选举两人——共计4人——组成一个所谓的“最高委员会”，

to be presided by a member from the Executive Committee
of the Ashkenasi Jewish Communal Association ( the
highest Russian-Jewish Authority in Shanghai) and
that this "Roof Committee" should then should then
decide over questions arising in dividing donations
collected by the two above-mentioned organizations.

The above resolution was rejected through voting.
A second resolution was offered by the Committee of
the "Eastjewcom" as follows:-

That the future newly elected Committee of
the "Eastjewcom" to be elected on the present
meeting should continue the work of the
"Eastjewcom" in the same manner as before, i.e.,
to continue functioning for the same purpose
for which it was originally organised, namely
to assist the Eastern European Jewish Refugees
from Poland, Lithuania and Latvia. At the
same time the future Committee should come
into contact with the "Centrjewcom", but the
forms of such contact to be decided upon by
the future Committee.

and this resolution was accepted at the meeting.

NOTE: It has to be stated that amongst the 250
persons present only 57 persons had voting
rights and able to produce receipts for
paid donations.
pages.zh:

该委员会由阿什肯纳兹犹太公会执行委员会（上海最高的俄裔犹太人权威机构）的一名成员主持，并由该“最高委员会”决定如何处理上述两个组织所募集捐款的分配问题。

上述决议经投票被否决。
“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”提出了第二项决议，内容如下：

在本次会议上选出的“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”新一届委员会，应继续以与以往相同的方式开展“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”的工作，即继续为其最初成立的目的而运作，也就是援助来自波兰、立陶宛和拉脱维亚的东欧犹太难民。同时，未来委员会应与“中央犹太难民救济委员会”建立联系，但联系的具体形式由未来委员会决定。

该项决议在会议上获得通过。

注：必须指出，在出席的250人中，只有57人拥有投票权，并能出示已捐款的收据。

pages.en:
- 6 -

A letter addressed to the President of the
meeting from Miss Margolis and M. Siogal, the two
representatives from "Joint", was then read by
U. Gertsenstein, Treasurer of "Eastjewcom", in
which an appeal to the "Eastjewcom" was made to
consider the needs of the 4000 destitute Jewish
Refugees from Central Europe and extend also to them
help, because all refugees were first of all Jews
and should receive similar treatment by the Jewish
Community in Shanghai. This letter was taken by
the Committee for consideration.

The emotion which started during the speech
of L.M. Rogovin, prevailed during the whole meeting
and protests directed against the "Centrjewcom"
continued to be heard in the room.

The next question on the programme was the
election of a new Executive Committee for the
"Eastjewcom", however after reading of the above
letter, the followers (about 15 in number) of the
"Centrjewcom", headed by L.M. Rogovin, left the
meeting, refusing to participate in the election
because they saw that the majority was against them and
for the old committee of the Eastjewcom and therefore
approving the past activities of A. Oppenheim as the
pages.zh:

随后，“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”财务主管U. Gertsenstein（音译）宣读了Margolis小姐和M. Siogal（音译）致会议主席的一封信，此二人是“联合委员会”的两名代表。信中呼吁“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”考虑4000名来自中欧的贫困犹太难民的需求，并向他们提供援助，因为所有难民首先都是犹太人，应当得到上海犹太社区的同等对待。该信件交由委员会审议。

在L.M. Rogovin演讲期间引发的情绪贯穿了整个会议，针对“中央犹太难民救济委员会”的抗议声在会场内持续不断。

议程上的下一个议题是选举“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”的新执行委员会，然而在宣读上述信件后，以L.M. Rogovin为首的“中央犹太难民救济委员会”支持者（约15人）离开了会场，拒绝参与选举，因为他们看到多数人与他们作对，而是支持“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”的旧委员会，从而认可A. Oppenheim作为

pages.en:
- 1 -

Chairman.

A. Oppenheim then made a speech in which he replied
to the accusation made by some of the speakers, stating
that the Eastjewcom Organization was founded for the sole
purpose to help the Jewish Refugees from Eastern Europe
and that he had collected donations for this purpose
only and had no right to share the money with any other
organization without the consent of the persons who
donated the money. He further stated that he is not
against the "Centrjewcom" and his opinion was that the
two organizations can collect money separately and that
such collection would be more successful than otherwise.
However being accused by some of the persons at the
meeting of nearly criminal activities, he does not wish
to carry on his duties as the Chairman any longer and
does not wish to be a candidate in the new election,
and left the room together with his committee members.

NOTE: A. Oppenheim agreed to put his name on the list of
candidates later being persistently asked by his
followers and as stated by some members of the
"Juntrjewcom". Such procedure was prearranged by
himself in order to show that he and his activities
are very much approved by the majority.

An election then took place and the following were
nominated as the members of the Executive Committee of
the "Eastjewcom":-

1) M. Genkin
2) U. Gertsenstein
3) B. Kopilovich
4) A. Oppenheim

主席的过往活动。

A. Oppenheim随后发表演讲，回应了一些发言者提出的指控。他指出，“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”组织的成立唯一目的是帮助来自东欧的犹太难民，他仅为此目的募集捐款，未经捐款人同意，无权将资金分享给任何其他组织。他进一步表示，他并不反对“中央犹太难民救济委员会”，他认为两个组织可以分别募集资金，且这种方式会比其他方式更成功。然而，由于在会议上被一些人指控犯有近乎犯罪的行为，他不愿再履行主席职责，也不愿成为新选举的候选人，并与他的委员会成员一同离开了会场。

注：A. Oppenheim后来同意将自己的名字列入候选人名单，这是在其支持者的坚持要求下，以及据“青年犹太难民救济委员会”（Juntrjewcom）某些成员所述。这一程序是他预先安排的，旨在表明他和他的活动得到了大多数人的高度认可。

随后进行了选举，以下人员被提名为“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”执行委员会委员：

pages.en:
- 8 -

The meeting was closed at 10.30 p.m. It must be
stated that all members of the "Centrjewcom" are also
supporters of the "Eastjewcom" because they have
contributed money in support of the Jewish Refugees from
Eastern Europe before the differences arose between the
two organizations, therefore were entitled to participate
at the general meeting.

It is significant that since the trouble between the
two organizations started, both organizations have lost
contributors, who are waiting until some solution is
reached in order to ascertain which particular organiza-
tion should be mostly supported. This does not refer to
the Shanghai Jewry only, but also to the Jewish Communi-
ties in outports, who used to send money to Shanghai and
at present are awaiting the results of the dispute.

It can be stated in general that the "Eastjewcom"
is supporting only the religious problems of the Jewry,
whilst the "Centrjewcom" has a broader mind and is for
the support of the whole Jewry, irrespective of their
citizenship or origin.

D.S.I.Gigerson.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,
Crime & Special Branch
pages.zh:
- 8 -

会议于晚上10:30结束。必须指出，“中央犹太难民救济委员会”的所有成员也是“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”的支持者，因为在两个组织发生分歧之前，他们曾捐款支持来自东欧的犹太难民，因此有权参加本次大会。

值得注意的是，自从两个组织之间发生纠纷以来，双方都失去了捐赠者，这些捐赠者正在等待达成某种解决方案，以确定主要应该支持哪个特定组织。这不仅涉及上海犹太界，也包括外埠的犹太社区，他们过去曾向上海汇款，目前正等待争端的结果。

总体而言，可以说“东欧犹太难民救济委员会”仅支持犹太界的宗教事务，而“中央犹太难民救济委员会”视野更广阔，主张支持整个犹太界，无论其国籍或出身如何。

D.S.I. Gigerson（音译）

外事、刑事及特别部门主管警官
